# Anatomy geometry kit

Source: https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy — downloaded 2026-10-15 from `main`.
Archive SHA-256: `4a994fca15b375602b470f76a5206c603b37a5bb5ae47d1e0f5e25aa5d5802c1`.

These unmodified MIT files are build-time geometry and verification tools. They do not
run in the application or pull a package, API key, or image generation service into it.
Keep `LICENSE` with redistributed copies. Joobi's original scene definitions live in
`scripts/sector-art/`. `line-ends.mjs` is the upstream browser line checker.

Regenerate: `node scripts/generate-sector-illustrations.mjs --audit`.
The complete skill read for this work is preserved in
`artifacts/anatomy-sectors-20261015/ANATOMY_SKILL.md`.
